description: Ships heard in the last hour inside a box (at most 5° on each side), largest first. List results are compact rows (mmsi, name, category, flag (ISO code from the MMSI), lat, lon, speed_kn, course_deg, length_m, destination, age_s, status, source); call get_vessel for full details of one ship. Private vessels (pleasure craft, sailing vessels and Class B transponders without a valid IMO number) are never listed or looked up individually; area and nearby results report how many were left out (private_vessels).

limit.description: Maximum number of ships to return

max_lat.description: Northern edge of the box, decimal degrees

max_lon.description: Eastern edge of the box, decimal degrees

min_lat.description: Southern edge of the box, decimal degrees

min_lon.description: Western edge of the box, decimal degrees
